heading: What each extension provides
text:
### What each extension provides [LNLS.8.1]

- `linear_scan: false` constrains **algorithmic shape** — which operations
  are O(1) or O(J_max) vs O(N_max).  It does not require pool
  allocation, presz, or `go_live`.
- `realtime` constrains the **allocation and lifecycle model** — all
  memory pre-allocated before `go_live`, INIT/LIVE phase discipline.
  It automatically enforces LNLS.3.2, 3.5, 3.6, 3.7, 3.8 as compile
  errors (see [LNLS.2.3]).  It does not enforce LNLS.3.1, 3.3, 3.4.

A program can use either, both, or neither.
